You can return or get a replacement for your Experiment Beauty product within 30 days of purchase. If your product arrived damaged, leaked, or had packaging that appeared switched or altered, you are eligible for a full refund or a free product replacement.
experimentbeauty.com
Please note that Experiment Beauty recently updated its product packaging (such as making the Softwear lip balm tubes slightly lighter, shinier, and changing the clear logo window). However, if you suspect you received a completely incorrect or counterfeit item—especially if you purchased it through a third-party seller like Amazon instead of the official Experiment Storefront—it is critical to reach out to their support team immediately to have it resolved.
